purpose: Eight AI-generated storyboard concept sketches; not final 3D renders.

Use case: illustration-story. Asset type: one portrait storyboard sketch, frame 1 of an eight-shot 30-second space adventure, for teenage short-video viewers. Create a SINGLE portrait 9:16 frame, no collage or panel layout.
Scene: a turquoise-white luminous spatial seam has opened into a tall irregular oval wormhole amid deep indigo space, a faint violet dust cloud and a few stars. A small original single-seat fighter bursts out toward the viewer and slightly sideways; its distinctive whole silhouette is legible. A few small amber relay lights are distant.
Subject design to establish continuity for later frames: flattened smooth seed-shaped compact petrol-blue ceramic hull, short curved nose, one small OFF-CENTRE dorsal fin, two recessed glowing turquoise vent-like propulsion slots integrated into the rear, narrow smoked canopy near the front, delicate copper panel seams; slightly asymmetric organic industrial shape; no broad wings, no separate engine pods. Not block-built or photorealistic. Original ship and portal designs, do not imitate a known sci-fi franchise.
Style: loose professional film storyboard / concept sketch, expressive graphite and black ink contours, visible construction strokes, restrained blue-grey digital gouache shading with selective turquoise and copper/amber light. Strong staging and motion lines, not a glossy finished poster. Dark space remains readable. Cinematic front three-quarter camera, mild perspective, full ship centred in the portrait safe area. No lettering, no captions, no logos, no watermark. Clear cyan-white opening rim with a dark distorted starfield inside, not a mechanical gate.

Two low copper-edged controls, gloved hands barely visible at bottom.
